identitySources.title: About the Ojibwe Language — Ojibwe People's Dictionary
identitySources.publisher: Ojibwe People's Dictionary, with University of Minnesota collaboration
identitySources.inspectionScope: Opening identification/range paragraphs, web-extracted lines 49–52, and publishing context at 104–107. Only naming and regional scope selected; no word entries, audio, images or linked resources inspected.
identitySources.evidence: Lists Chippewa among names used for Ojibwe. Describes a Great Lakes-centered language range including Michigan. Separately identifies the dictionary's Central Southwestern variety with Minnesota, Wisconsin and Canadian border-lakes communities.
identitySources.countReason: Narrow name-identification check only; do not add a substantive source count to any queue card.
